name: protein_controls
description: Curated positive/negative control proteins for BLAST and interpretation engines.
citation: UniProt curated annotations (2026_01 release); verified manually for BioNexus demos.

records.label: Tumor suppressor p53 (P04637), DNA-binding core
records.summary: True p53 core-domain sequence; blast should recover known p53 hits and match annotation 'tumor protein p53'.

records.label: Green fluorescent protein (GFP), Aequorea victoria
records.summary: Established non-pathological control; blast of this sequence should not be annotated as a disease-associated tumor suppressor.

records.label: Hemoglobin subunit beta (HBB), wild-type reference
records.summary: Reference human beta-globin; sequencing/alignment control for the variant pipelines.
